headline: WNBA Finals Game 1: Valkyries beat the Dream 68-64
whyCareReason: ESPN and CBS list Saturday's final as 68-64. Golden State lead 1-0. Game 2 is unplayed.
teaser: Gabby Williams scored 26. Angel Reese had 14 points and 12 rebounds and was scoreless in the second half.
story: ESPN and CBS Sports list Game 1 of the 2026 WNBA Finals as Golden State Valkyries 68, Atlanta Dream 64 on Saturday 17 October at Chase Center. CBS reported Gabby Williams scored 26 points and the Golden State bench scored 20. Angel Reese finished with 14 points and 12 rebounds and was scoreless in the second half. Allisha Gray, cleared to play with a hand injury, led Atlanta with 19 points. The series is 1-0. An earlier 82-76 line is withdrawn. Game 2 is Monday 19 October at 8:00 p.m. ET at Chase Center on USA, Peacock and CNBC, and it has no score.
stakes: Best of seven. Golden State host Game 2. Atlanta host Game 3 on Wednesday 21 October at State Farm Arena.
rivalryAngle: A four-point final, with Atlanta's leading scorer held without a point after half-time.
